classification: Candidate35 fabric correction retains aggregate cutout coverage in all 605 matching-input comparisons; separate searchlight lighting coverage remains unresolved

limitations: Equal aggregate passing-sample counts do not establish an identical coverage mask.
Keys match referenced position constants and selected raster/depth state, not every pixel-shader input or other scene objects.
Different simulation times are matched by exact input values, not by CPU/GPU frame number.
Zero passing samples alone do not identify occlusion, depth/stencil rejection, culling, or shader discard.

fixture.note: Initial fixture attempts stopped because the optional D3D12 debug SDK component is absent. The final fixture explicitly reports that limitation and passes the actual GPU query checks.

probe.scope: Actual selected guest draws only; no draw-state changes, duplicated draws, screenshots, or desktop input.
probe.bounds: Existing draw trace stops at 300 frames, 15 seconds or 512 MiB; private game watchdog 180 seconds. Own query heap never reuses slots and skips active guest queries.

fabric_shadow_audit.conclusion: The global shadow program already rejects alpha below 0.5 and is unchanged. Clearing the material hardware-alpha flag does not remove this native shader discard.
limitations: This is an asset/program audit, not runtime shadow coverage verification.
The former material hardware threshold was about 0.501960814; its additional effect in the shadow path has not been measured.
This does not establish visually identical shadow edges or acceptance on physical Xbox 360.

limitations: Matching animation payloads and finite/smooth matrices do not establish correct animated geometry or lighting.
The position-input comparison excludes shader literal slots; the distinct native vertex programs still need execution/output comparison.
Zero surviving lighting coverage remains unexplained: later occlusion, rasterization, shader discard, and depth/stencil rejection have not been distinguished.
No animation suppression, depth override or lighting fix follows from this audit.

limitations: Passing-sample totals are not pixel masks or full visual acceptance; coverage of unmatched inputs remains unpaired.
The searchlight body and lamp face have visible albedo coverage but zero later lighting coverage in both candidates. These are observations, not proof of faulty animation or a diagnosed lighting bug.
The distinct vertex shaders, intervening occlusion, depth/stencil tests and discard behavior need further causal tracing.
Authored animation bytes are intact. This does not establish correct transformed geometry, beam brightness, or visual behavior.
The shared shadow shader retains its 0.5 discard; the prior extra hardware threshold was about 0.501960814. Runtime shadow-edge equivalence is unverified.
Candidate34 billboard mip fix has not yet been combined with candidate35. Advertisement readability, rain appearance, traversal/performance, audio, physical Xbox and system link remain unverified.
No LIVE package, installed map, or shared runtime was promoted.
